access.title: Register to access
access.subtitle: Clinical, academic and non-commercial research use of the DAND Scale is free. Just register to download the scale, the manual, and use the automatic calculator.

features.privacy: No patient data stored on the server

access.footnote: Free access · No password to remember

industryNotice.title: Industry / Pharma / CRO / Sponsored Clinical Trials.
industryNotice.body: Use of the DAND Scale by pharmaceutical companies, CROs, in the context of sponsored clinical trials or for other commercial purposes is subject to a specific request to Fondazione Dravet ETS. Contact:
industryNotice.afterContact: Fondazione Dravet ETS will evaluate the request and contact the applicant to agree on the terms of use and any collaboration.

login.title: Log in to the DAND Scale
login.description: Enter your email: we'll send you a link to log in, no password needed.
login.note: If you don't have an account yet, one will be created automatically and you'll be asked to complete your registration.
login.switchToSignIn: Already have an account? Log in
login.errorEmailInUse: An account already exists with this email. Try logging in.
login.linkSentDescription: We've sent a login link to {{email}}. Open it to log in — no password needed.
login.errorSendFailed: Could not send the login link. Please try again later.
login.resetSentDescription: If an account exists for {{email}}, we've sent a link to set a new password. Check your Spam folder too.
login.errorResetFailed: Could not send the password reset email. Please try again later.
login.errorResetTooMany: Too many requests. Please try again in a few minutes.

finishSignIn.confirmEmailDescription: You opened the login link on a different device: confirm the email address it was sent to.
finishSignIn.invalidLinkDescription: This login link is invalid or has expired.
finishSignIn.linkExpiredError: This link is no longer valid. Request a new one from the login page.
finishSignIn.wrongEmailError: Incorrect email or the link is no longer valid.
